t: This is the north east lodge and gates to Highgate Western Cemetery, in Camden. Both lodge and gates were designed by Stephen Geary, a British architect who lived from 1797 to 1854. Geary was also an inventor and an entrepreneur, and from 1850 he became a temperance activist. The gates mark the threshold of the cemetery, and the lodge beside them is the work of a man who put his hand to many different things.
